family, identity, authority transition, lifecycle relation, topology, effect,
closure law, or composition law that cannot be expressed honestly by composing
other accepted atoms while preserving the same meaning.

Prime review evaluates the complete candidate semantic-atom family and every
proposed realization projection, not only functions, carriers, or each atom in
isolation. The family includes every proposed identity, authority transition,
lifecycle relation, topology, function, composition law, effect, and closure
law. A function-and-carrier-only pass does not establish whole-family Prime.

At a material semantic boundary, Prime contraction applies to each candidate
semantic atom and then to the complete family produced by those contractions.

identity, authority, function, lifecycle, topology, effect, or projection
meaning. Local Prime-conformance of realization units does not prove the
semantic family globally Prime.

definition.name: Core Claims
definition.declared_meaning_excerpt:
1. No finite actor is presumed to hold the complete material workspace in
   active attention.
2. A useful frame is finite and sufficient for a declared evaluation family.
3. The evaluations to be made determine the material attention surface.
4. Human authority may declare a practical project frame set from accumulated
   practice without deriving a unique frame partition mechanically.

   another. Hierarchy is one optional relation.

   coordinate systems.

   inventory, basis, and time.

   decision authority from its breadth, usefulness, actor, or implementation
   technology.

   They are not failed evaluations or implied acceptance.

Spec-driven development treats specification as constitutional source, not
commentary on code. Methodology defines the process constitution. Intent,
product definition, and requirements define the project constitution.
Specification defines `WHAT`. Design and realization define `HOW`. Every
STDO-defined product publishes a layout-neutral `stdo_<label>.json` definition
that locates its governing constitution, local constitutional decisions,
collective reference-frame bases, `WHAT`, independent build-tenant `HOW`

verification obligations. Design defines the structural how, and ADRs are one

pipeline: each major boundary reduces the space of lawful interpretations and
must surface major ambiguity explicitly. Ambiguity detection is mandatory;
blocking or escalation is policy-driven by declared risk appetite, except for
hard-stop prerequisite failures. Products, applications, modules, graph
functions, build tenants, and runtime surfaces are implementations of the
constitutional documents, not substitutes for them. Scenarios verify
operational meaning where capability claims need end-to-end proof. Code

intent, and product definition; code must be derivable from requirements and

explicit deferment. Every design record must ground itself in requirements.

or withdrawal, not silent in-place mutation. New intent emerges from real use
cases hitting the current model through explicit gap analysis, not ad hoc
pressure. Sprints are execution-control batches for pricing proof cost and
forcing close review; they are not authority layers and cannot hide drift.

The [F1, F4, F5 and F6 premises](FOUNDATIONS.md#foundational-commitments), applied

assurance owner adds that independence premise. These premises constrain the
Executive, Worker and Reviewer contracts below; they do not force three roles.

and event-driven attention policy. Existing Product authority chooses adoption,
direct versus coordinated activation and actual grants.

The Executive frame does not introduce `authorize` or `no_action` as peer

bounded candidate disposition remains exactly `accept`, `local_repair`,

Executive sequences delivery around a steel thread: the smallest real,
runnable path from a supported Product entry to a material outcome through
the selected composition. Establish that path early and expand it in bounded
increments. Where it already exists, extend or revalidate the affected
thread. Select increments by consequential uncertainty, dependency and
interface reach, and failure impact.

`candidate_ready` binds the exact candidate and the transition evidence required

`STDO-UP-007` determines when independent review is required and what makes it
traceable. `STDO-UP-022` determines exact assurance-boundary and qualification

F1–F4 require an evaluation to preserve the selected outcome, exact subject,
meaning and material joins; F5 bounds what one actor can cover; F6 prevents
broader coverage from absorbing another owner. Given Product work with those
material questions, separate bounded evaluations must retain their claim and
authority boundaries. This profile chooses the following twelve archetypes;
the cited domain owners supply their predicates and an adopting Product chooses
material instantiations. Neither Foundations nor adoption requires twelve

F1 and F2 require evidence congruent with the claimed outcome; F3 binds the
actual subject; F4 prevents local proof from proving an unevaluated composition;
F6 preserves the claim owner's meaning. Therefore a testing result can support

four frame archetypes and their evidence boundaries. Spec's testing and
assurance owners, the Product and accepted design select the actual claims,
required populations and acceptance policy; the four-frame inventory is not a
consequence of F1–F6 alone.

User acceptance is the primary Product-outcome evidence frame when the claim is
that a user can use the Product. It may be automated only when automation
faithfully occupies the declared user frame and does not gain a path or
capability unavailable to that user. Automation can execute acceptance
evidence; it cannot assume acceptance authority.

The expected output is necessary but not sufficient. Reaching it through a

promoted to evidence that the real participant or Product composition was

module-derived unit lane owned by `DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md`; public module
contracts are valid unit-proof subjects. Internal combinatorial complexity
determines the proportional size and strategy of that evidence. Its highest
discriminating value is often in algebras, calculations, transformations,
parsers, reducers, state machines, decision tables, admission predicates,
conservation relations, and bounded algorithms with strong independently
derived oracles. A unit test whose oracle merely repeats the implementation or
whose cases follow incidental code branches provides weak or circular
evidence.

discriminate for its exact claim. It is not indexed by test, assertion, file,

A UX surface review under this method should answer:

- `SPEC_METHOD.md` governs constitutional process, authority flow, repricing, and migration law.
- `ODD_METHOD.md` governs graph-native constructive carrier law. UX surfaces are projection / query surfaces under §10 of that method.
- `DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` governs deterministic realization discipline at the module level. `UX_METHOD.md` refines it for UX modules.
- `TICKET_METHOD.md` governs ticket and sprint lifecycle. UX work may use sprint compliance escrow under §13B when the sprint boundary makes deferred proof visible, bounded, and payable.
- `WORLD_MODEL_METHOD.md` governs world-model semantic law for products that have a world-model dimension. UX surfaces over world-model state still bind through `AssetSurface` (or equivalent) per §7.
`UX_METHOD.md` is not:

`UX_METHOD.md` adopts the **Elm Architecture** as the constitutional UX process model and refines `DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` for UX surfaces. The model: typed `State` held by the runtime, typed `Msg` algebra, pure `Update : (Msg, State) → (State, Cmd)`, pure `View : State → ViewTree`, side effects as `Cmd` values interpreted at a declared effect membrane that returns `Msg` to the reducer. The view does not own continuation (UX twin of `ODD_METHOD.md` §11.5A); the **Msg-replay test** is the discipline check. The realization stack is the project's choice, recorded in the design module along with justification of model preservation. The method tests realizations against §4–§10 and the §14 failure patterns; it does not rank stacks, languages, or frameworks.

determinations.source_excerpt: The method proceeds through these stages.
Gather source evidence from the strongest available surfaces:
Index and locate the source surfaces that may support semantic claims.
Produce reviewable intermediate surfaces from traced source objects:
Qualify traced observations into lawful world-model claims.
Write the accepted qualified claims into the attribute ledger.

Identify bounded contexts and the candidate entities that actually cohere
inside them.

Project entity cuts from the attribute ledger with enough semantic
context for alignment and reasoning.

Add treatment surfaces, covariance edges, adjoint mappings, and temporal
reference artifacts.
Publish immutable cuts of the published domain artifact.

Stitch published domain artifacts, their fragments, and their published
entity cuts into higher-order world models without erasing local
authority.

Use the semantic kernel as a tether for probabilistic alignment across domains,
entity cuts, artifacts, and projections.
Emit familiar outputs from the same semantic kernel:

Where delivery requires real execution, compile accepted semantic
understanding into deterministic executable artifacts.

If delivery needs justify it, expose traversal or query capability over
published domain artifacts and composed world models.
Every published entity cut must be prompt-sufficient for reasoning.

The materialized entity cut is an artifact of the world-model builder,
not a raw artifact of the source system.
Published world-model truth should be:
The attribute ledger is the immediate semantic source of an entity cut.

Entities are recovered, not invented. A builder project constructs an entity
cut by trawling authoritative source surfaces for the boundaries the operating
model already commits to, then qualifying them into published truth.

An entity cut is admissible when its identity, boundary, authority, state,
evidence, treatment, covariance, and ambiguity are explicit, traceable, and
discriminated from plausible alternatives at evidence altitude proportional to
the claim.

"Discriminated from plausible alternatives" means the cut states why this
boundary rather than a nearby one the operating model would treat differently.
The claim carries its own discrimination; a stronger claim needs stronger
discrimination.

A published entity cut makes the eight admissibility surfaces — identity,
boundary, authority, state, evidence, treatment, covariance, and ambiguity —
visible and traceable, each as a stated value, stated absence, or stated
non-applicability, and records the basis on which identity was discriminated.

This law is the representation-substrate specialization of *Entity Cut
Construction Law*. It applies only where the builder operates over a declared
representation space in which identity is a geometric direction — a learned
representation, an embedding over ledger claims, or an equivalent metric
space. It is not required for ordinary institutional recovery.

This guide supports sufficient interpreted context under [Foundations](FOUNDATIONS.md) and the shared [transformation library](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md). Clear writing preserves the governing layer and material determinations; shortening prose alone establishes no semantic or operational improvement.
Write as if the reader is technically fluent and short on time.

1. Prefer direct positive statements over contrast framing.
2. Remove setup paragraphs that announce what the section will say.
3. Use concrete nouns and verbs instead of motivational or promotional language.
4. Keep one claim per sentence when possible.
5. Prefer precise technical vocabulary over vague intensifiers.
6. Use examples only when they reduce ambiguity.
7. Do not write filler transitions whose only purpose is tone.

- “simply”
- “just”
- “clearly”
- “obviously”
- “powerful”
- “robust”
- “seamless”
- “game-changing”
- generic reassurance
- dramatic phrasing

field_semantics.bounded_author_binding: Author represented an identified predicate, applicability, obligations and latitude with typed owner/dependency/result/argument bindings; not an independent completeness judgment.
field_semantics.source_carried_clause: Exact available source and paragraph spans with a source excerpt; representation_kind and interpretation_standing distinguish definitions, pending conditions, consumers and non-deciding locators. This is not completed semantic interpretation.
field_semantics.source_clauses: Exact byte spans and hashes reacquire blocks. Diagnostic lines and lexical roles are hints; they establish neither modal force nor semantic sufficiency.
field_semantics.dependencies: String determination IDs for authored contract dependencies only. Source links and scope are typed separately in dependency_relations.
field_semantics.argument: Adopted premises, conditional support and extra policy remain distinct. A source argument route is not an independently proved entailment.
field_semantics.result_mapping: Domain data and decisions are not verdict aliases. Instance evidence must bind the exact claimed predicate, actual performance, effects, authority and required coverage.
field_semantics.empty_fields: An empty extraction is not proof of no source duty, exception or result map.
field_semantics.predicate: Null for a definition/data row or a non-deciding locator means no assessment predicate is asserted. Null for construction_pending means the available source still requires authored decomposition, not missing source or an indeterminate domain verdict.
field_semantics.representation_kind: constraint, definition_data, consumer_binding or non_deciding_locator; this partitions work, not independent law counts. Definition bodies can contain embedded constraints, named in their remaining work.
field_semantics.owner: path resolves the single source_members pin; anchor and body_sha256 identify the exact heading body. Lines are diagnostic.
field_semantics.clause_id: A local cN in a row resolves to that row ID plus #cN. Source byte spans and SHA-256 authenticate the precise quoted block; no whole-source duplication.
field_semantics.applicability_ref: Resolve owner_families[path].applicability; local applicability overrides only this row.
field_semantics.consumers: Stable determination IDs, inverse of the authored dependencies list; exact owner is recovered from the referenced row.
field_semantics.remaining_work_ref: Resolve remaining_work_contracts by representation kind; per-owner ID partition enumerates the concrete unfinished units.
